title: Saint Joseph’s church, Portland row
html_source: This was a convent in Joyce’s day, no longer in service in the 21st century.

anchor.prefix:
Richmond street. All raised untidy caps. Father Conmee greeted them more than once benignly. Christian brother boys. 

 Father Conmee smelt incense on his right hand as he walked.
anchor.suffix:
. For aged and virtuous females. Father 1986#181Conmee raised his hat to the Blessed Sacrament. Virtuous: but occasionally they were also badtempered. 

 Near Aldborough house Fath
